title: The Recovered guard's refusal names each missing carry line and the passing form, and a carry label after a Done tag counts
why: Owner, 23:50 CST Nov 14, verbatim (relayed by the consultant 23:52 CST): "we need to fix the guard". Meaning is the consultant's reading, not owner-typed: the Recovered guard (lint/report_guard.py, function recovered_problem) that refused the consultant's reports 4 times after compaction (consultant's count; not read by triage). Ask, from the consultant: (1) the refusal names each missing carry line with "and" plus the passing form; (2) a carry label after a Done tag (for example "- OTHER: Handoff gave:") counts as a carry line. Ruling home: this step. Lane asked of the coordinator at 23:52 CST Nov 14; not started. Kin: step refusal-names-way-out (the Recovered guard refused the coordinator's report three times on Nov 11 when the line sat after "OTHER:"; its refusal never says the line must open its own bullet) and step guard-false-alarm-cull (names the same guard). Not read by triage: recovered_problem's code, the four refused reports. First act of a lane: reproduce each refusal on a fixture, red then green, then change the message and the label match; a change that lets through a report main refuses is a widening and goes to the coordinator first.
source: owner 23:50 CST Nov 14 via consultant 23:52 CST (to triage)
